bagshuiAnalysis.title: Bagshui Addon Analysis — Leveraged Patterns (NOT Reinventing the Wheel)
bagshuiAnalysis.description: Analysis of existing Bagshui addon. BankAltExport uses the SAME core WoW APIs — not reinventing the wheel. Works standalone (doesn't require Bagshui).
diagram: │  GetContainerNumSlots(bagId)         → Returns slot count (0 if not available)     │
│  GetContainerItemLink(bagId, slot)   → Returns item link with embedded itemId      │
│  GetContainerItemInfo(bagId, slot)   → Returns texture, count, locked, quality     │
│  GetItemInfo(itemId)                 → Returns name, quality, type, subtype, max   │
│  BANKFRAME_OPENED  → Auto-scan bank when player opens bank at banker NPC           │
│  BAG_UPDATE        → Bag contents changed (triggers delayed scan)                  │
│  • Item link parsing: string.find(link, 'item:(%d+)') extracts itemId              │
│  • GetItemInfo for richer data: itemType, itemSubtype, maxStackCount               │
│  • Charges handling: Negative count from SuperWoW = charges (math.abs)             │
│  • Quality fallback: GetContainerItemInfo can return -1, use GetItemInfo           │
│  • Name fallback: If GetItemInfo fails, parse [name] from link                     │
│  • Not all users have Bagshui installed                                            │
│  • Uses same proven WoW API patterns                                               │
│  • Installer doesn't require Bagshui as dependency                                 │
